quest.subject: English Language & Literature (184)
quest.title: English Language & Literature — Class 10 December 2026 Quest

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Reading Comprehension. which statement best describes an inference?

options.A: A fact copied word for word
options.B: A conclusion drawn from textual clues
options.D: A personal opinion unrelated to the text

questions.explanation: An inference is a reasoned conclusion based on evidence and prior understanding.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Reading Comprehension. the phrase “the plan was feasible” means the plan was:

options.B: Practical and capable of being carried out

questions.explanation: Feasible means possible or practical to do.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Tenses. choose the correct form: “By next Friday, they ____ the project.”
questions.explanation: Future perfect describes an action completed before a specified future time.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Modals. “You ____ have informed us earlier; the delay caused difficulty.”
questions.explanation: Should have expresses an expected action that was not done.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Reported Speech. direct: Mira said, “I have finished my work.”

options.A: Mira said that she has finished her work.
options.B: Mira said that she had finished her work.
options.C: Mira says she finished my work.
options.D: Mira told that I had finished work.

questions.explanation: Present perfect generally backshifts to past perfect after a past reporting verb.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Grammar – Subject Verb Agreement. choose the correct verb: “Neither the teacher nor the students ____ absent.”
questions.explanation: With neither…nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, “students”.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Writing – Analytical Paragraph. when comparing two data sets in an analytical paragraph, the writer should:

options.B: Identify key trends, comparisons and relevant figures

questions.explanation: An analytical paragraph selects and interprets significant patterns in the data.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Writing – Formal Letter. a letter to a municipal authority about poor waste collection should use:
questions.explanation: A civic complaint should be clear, respectful and evidence-based.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing First Flight – Prose. in “A Letter to God”, Lencho’s faith is primarily shown through his:

options.B: Confidence that God will help after the hailstorm

questions.explanation: Lencho writes to God because he firmly believes help will come.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing First Flight – Poetry. in “Dust of Snow”, the small natural incident changes the poet’s:
questions.explanation: The falling snow from the hemlock tree changes the poet’s mood.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Footprints Without Feet. in “A Triumph of Surgery”, Tricki’s recovery is mainly due to:
questions.explanation: The vet restores Tricki’s health through controlled feeding and activity.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Footprints Without Feet. in “The Thief’s Story”, Hari Singh returns to Anil because he:

options.B: Recognises the value of trust and education

questions.explanation: Anil’s trust and the possibility of learning prompt Hari’s return.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Literary Devices. “The wind whispered through the trees” uses:
questions.explanation: The wind is given the human action of whispering.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Vocabulary in Context. the word “reluctant” means:
questions.explanation: Reluctant means not willing or hesitant to act.

questions.subject: English Language & Literature
questions.question: December challenge: During winter revision and annual assessment planning, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Integrated Language Skills. a response that is both concise and well-supported should:

options.B: State the point and support it with relevant evidence

questions.explanation: A focused answer makes a clear claim and supports it with relevant evidence.
